name: Streaming quality optimization — realtime modulation continuity

asi.per_case_gaps: EDM 1.5x centroid=0.248 (-7.5pts), perc 2.0x batch_sim=0.62 (-7.6pts), perc 1.5x batch_sim=0.83 (-3.5pts)
asi.previous_session_dead_ends: lower blend threshold, shelf cutoff changes, flux-modulated shelf, lower WSOLA onset thresholds, AND onset condition, sub-bass cutoff 220, tail gain compensation

description: Raise shelf threshold 1.02→1.03: -0.4, harm +0.2 but EDM -1.1

asi.hypothesis: Higher shelf dead zone (1.03) to eliminate harmonic coloration
asi.rollback_reason: EDM energy_gain at 1.5x falls in 1.02-1.03 range, loses needed shelf
asi.key_insight: EDM 1.5x energy_gain is between 1.02-1.03, right at the current threshold boundary
asi.next_action_hint: Need per-signal approach, not global threshold changes

description: HF energy-driven shelf: EDM +2.8 but perc -8.3, fmt fail

asi.hypothesis: Use measured HF energy loss to drive shelf instead of ratio_distance proxy
asi.rollback_reason: fmt fail + percussive over-boosted: HF shelf too aggressive for percussive (0.6 coeff)
asi.key_insight: EDM +2.8 validates approach — HF tracking correctly identifies EDM 1.5x spectral loss. But percussive also shows HF loss from transient smearing, and shelf hurts batch_sim
asi.next_action_hint: Reduce HF shelf aggressiveness (lower coeff) and add energy_gain gate to exclude percussive-like signals

description: HF energy-driven shelf with energy_gain gate: +0.6, EDM 970.8 (+1.7) from better centroid correction

asi.hypothesis: Track HF energy ratio (input vs output) to drive shelf. Gate behind energy_gain<1.10 to exclude percussive broadband loss
asi.improvement: EDM 1.5x centroid correction via direct HF loss measurement instead of ratio_distance proxy

description: Lower HF threshold 1.08→1.05: no change (HF ratio always > 1.08 when gated)

asi.hypothesis: Lower hf_threshold to catch smaller HF losses
asi.rollback_reason: No effect — HF ratio is always well above 1.08 when energy_gain gate passes

asi.hypothesis: More aggressive HF correction coefficient (0.5 vs 0.4)
asi.improvement: EDM centroid further corrected, no regression elsewhere
